title: DUB: Discrete Unit Back-translation for Speech Translation

layout.note: Two panels side by side divided by a thick vertical rule, each captioned below with a letter and title. (a) is a bottom-up column: speech, hatched extractor frame, unit row, then U2T and T2U boxes side by side under the text box. (b) is a 2x2 grid split by grey cross rules with one circled step per quadrant, linked by a grey block arrow, curved arrows and a straight arrow.

lesson: Draw a data-augmentation recipe as numbered steps in the quadrants of one box with a stack of coloured cards for each data set, tag the synthetic samples and outline them in red, and reuse the model-box colours of the structure panel so the two panels read as one story.
